title: No error is printed when attempting to export a project or PCK with a non-existent export preset name (or no export presets configured)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.dev 51105ccbe58381774ecd7a7486d564b202a5192e

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (51105ccbe) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9649) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.55 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

No error is printed when attempting to export a project or PCK with a non-existent export preset name (or no export presets configured).

For example, if you have a project with a `Windows Desktop` export preset but try to export `Windows` instead:

```
godot --export-pack "Windows" ~/out_headless2.pck --path ~/test-visual-shader/
```

This will result in a non-zero exit code (and no PCK created), but no error message printed:

```
[   0% ] first_scan_filesystem | Started Project initialization (5 steps)
[   0% ] first_scan_filesystem | Scanning file structure...
[  16% ] first_scan_filesystem | Loading global class names...
[  33% ] first_scan_filesystem | Verifying GDExtensions...
[  50% ] first_scan_filesystem | Creating autoload scripts...
[  66% ] first_scan_filesystem | Initializing plugins...
[  83% ] first_scan_filesystem | Starting file scan...
[ DONE ] first_scan_filesystem
```

Compare this with a successful export:

```
[   0% ] first_scan_filesystem | Started Project initialization (5 steps)
[   0% ] first_scan_filesystem | Scanning file structure...
[  16% ] first_scan_filesystem | Loading global class names...
[  33% ] first_scan_filesystem | Verifying GDExtensions...
[  50% ] first_scan_filesystem | Creating autoload scripts...
[  66% ] first_scan_filesystem | Initializing plugins...
[  83% ] first_scan_filesystem | Starting file scan...
[ DONE ] first_scan_filesystem

[   0% ] savepack | Started Packing (102 steps)
[   1% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-0692f7496158fe11f87f40df2c76d1d7-grp.res
[  26% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/imported/icon.svg-218a8f2b3041327d8a5756f3a245f83b.ctex
[  26% ] savepack | Storing File: res://icon.svg.import
[  50% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-7dfb8f86c662127e6b6ae2043f3e6d9a-new_shader.res
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-14584830dbc22d3f76a596eed5f4948e-node_3d.scn
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://grp.tres.remap
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://new_shader.tres.remap
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://node_3d.tscn.remap
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://icon.svg
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://.godot/uid_cache.bin
[  74% ] savepack | Storing File: res://project.binary
[ DONE ] savepack
```

This can be difficult to troubleshoot if you don't look at exit codes, so there should be an error message (ideally one that lists all available export presets).

There should also be a dedicated error message when trying to export a project with no export presets configured.

**Edit:** I've tested this on Linux and I do get errors this time:

```
ERROR: Invalid export preset name: Linux/X11.
The following presets were detected in this project's `export_presets.cfg`:

        "Linux"
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project with a main scene configured.
- Add an export preset to it.
- Use [command line export](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/editor/command_line_tutorial.html) with a non-existent preset name.
- Remove `export_presets.cfg`, then try exporting the project again (with no presets configured).
- Notice how the engine exits with a non-zero exit code, but no error is printed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
